Chapter 494: Chapter 3 Sala: Our Chance is Here! (Please Subscribe)

At the moment when the three Goddesses completed their assessment of the Eighth Stage Martial Tao Part,

the real-time rankings of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path would be ‘updated’.

Of course, only Lin Yuan had access to these updates; as for outsiders?

They would have to wait until the evolution rankings across all boards were simultaneously updated at dawn each day to see them.

“Martial Path Evolutionary Path… Chikun Star Domain ranking… first…” Lin Yuan glanced at the Chikun Evolution Rankings, not at all surprised.

When the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was still at the Seventh Rank, it had managed to dominate over the two major Eighth Rank Evolution Paths, ranking second on the Chikun Evolution Rankings.

...

Now that he had uploaded the Eighth Layer Part, the evaluation had greatly improved, leaping to first place on the Chikun Evolution Rankings—completely expected.

“Hm? First place on the Annan Evolution Rankings too?” Lin Yuan skimmed through the higher-level rankings.

The Annan Evolution Rankings, belonging to the Annan Star Alliance, listed the strongest top hundred Evolution Paths born within a Star Alliance.

The Chikun Star Domain was under the Annan Star Alliance; the number of Star Domains encompassed by a single Star Alliance was generally in the hundreds to thousands.

Lin Yuan remembered that, when the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was at the Seventh Rank, it ranked exactly one hundredth on the Annan Evolution Rankings.

The top hundred strongest Evolution Paths recorded by the Annan Star Alliance included five Ninth Stage Evolution Paths.

Even so, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path still managed to assert itself as the leader of its rankings, illustrating the emphasis the three Goddesses placed on it.

“This exposure will definitely cause a surge in the number of Evolvers following the Martial Path Evolutionary Path,” Lin Yuan felt pleased.

The evolution rankings of the great Star Domains and Star Alliances, apart from being a recognition for the listed Evolution Paths, serve as a significant avenue for exposure.

In any publicly accessible Virtual World, the Central Plaza Area is invariably located at the most central position.

And the Evolution Rankings will be displayed at the very heart of the Central Plaza Area.

Any Evolver entering the Virtual World for the first time is almost forcibly made to view the Evolution Paths on the Evolution Rankings.

“Let’s take a look at the Southern Star Region Evolution Rankings… Hmm… not in the top hundred…” Lin Yuan continued to look further up, slightly shaking his head.

The Southern Star Region is one of the five major Star Regions of Human Civilization.

Besides the Southern Star Region, there are also the Eastern Star Region, the Western Star Region, the Northern Star Region,

and the Central Star Region.

The current territory of Human Civilization is essentially composed of these five major Star Regions.

The smallest Central Star Region, among the five major Star Regions, encompasses nearly a hundred thousand Star Alliances.

As for the other four Star Regions, they are constantly expanding, with the largest Star Region already comprising over two hundred thousand Star Alliances.

The Milky Way Star Region, where Lin Yuan is currently located, as well as the previous Chikun Star Domain and Annan Star Alliance, all belong to the Southern Star Region.

With eighteen thousand Star Alliances, the Southern Star Region’s Evolution Rankings are extremely competitive; at least for now, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path does not make it into the top hundred.

“It makes sense, no matter how great the potential of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, it is only an Eighth Rank Evolution Path for now. Surpassing some Ninth Rank Evolution Paths is already remarkable; how could it possibly compete with the Evolution Paths included in the Star Region-level rankings…”

Lin Yuan was well aware of this.

The potential was not the only factor in the ranking on the boards; besides, every Evolution Path ranked at the Star Region level had notable potential.

Lin Yuan had never underestimated the geniuses of Human Civilization’s history; many geniuses did not reach the end due to various accidents, not because their chosen path was flawed.

“Right,”

“Goddess of Wisdom,”

“I should be an Evolutionary Scholar now, right?”

Lin Yuan suddenly asked. There were many conditions to become an Evolutionary Scholar, the most challenging one was to create a stable, new Eighth Rank Evolution Path.

And Lin Yuan had just achieved this.

“Assessing qualifications for the Galaxy Master… Congratulations to the Galaxy Master for becoming a new Evolutionary Scholar within Human Civilization…”

The solemn and indifferent voice of the Goddess of Wisdom sounded.

At the same time,

various emails from the Central Star Domain were sent to Lin Yuan’s mailbox.

The Central Star Domain, the core Star Domain of Human Civilization’s Central Star Region, is the original den of Human Civilization, where countless important resources converge.

Every citizen who can reside in the Central Star Domain for a long time has a significant background and heritage.

Many Eighth Rank Evolvers yearn to serve as officials on an ordinary planet in the Central Star Domain.

However, it is usually difficult to achieve, as even the most common Life Planet in the Central Star Domain has immeasurable value.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan scanned the multitude of emails.

Almost identical to civic rank promotions, these emails were basically about explanations and information regarding the status of an Evolutionary Scholar.

First and foremost, any Evolutionary Scholar automatically owns a Research Planet in the Central Star Domain.

This Research Planet, belonging entirely to the Evolutionary Scholar, is used for developing personal achievements.

It should be noted that a Research Planet is far more valuable than a common Life Planet, and even some main stars of Star Systems cannot compare.

Just this Research Planet itself is beyond measure, not quantifiable by hundreds of thousands of Cubic Universe Crystals.

Some Ninth Rank Evolvers do not even have the authority to own a Research Planet.

It’s not a matter of Cosmic Crystals here, but of authority; in the Central Star Domain, becoming the owner of a planet is more than an issue of wealth.

“And there’s the ability to access numerous secret materials collected by Human Civilization, as well as joining the Science Institute, Evolution Institute…”

Lin Yuan gained a general understanding of what it meant to be an Evolutionary Scholar.

To sum it up, that would be treasure.

The treasure of the Human Alliance.

For the whole of Human Civilization, even losing an entire Star Domain of ordinary citizens could not compare to the loss of a single Evolutionary Scholar.
